title: &dWhat the Dead Carry
subtitle: Mob LootBags: six tiers, four strange bags, two machines and a ragpicker.

quests.title: &dWhat the Dead Carry
quests.subtitle: Their fingers only open at the end.
description: &6The Keeper&r
&f&o"The dead don't hoard gold. They hoard what they couldn't put down. Somebody has to pick it up."&r

A letter, a ring, a loaf for a road that ended: when a Remnant falls, its fingers finally open. &6Old Pell&r, who picks the ash behind the shrine for whatever falls out, calls it spoils. &o"Everything the dead carry, they carried for a reason. Usually a bad one."&r

&7Hostile monsters drop &6loot bags&7 when you kill them: about one kill in seven for something your size, more from bigger things, a quarter as often from spawner cages. Only your kills count (your pets' and arrows' too). Open one.

quests.title: Six Weights of Grief
quests.subtitle: Common to Mythic.
description: Six tiers: &fCommon&r, &aUncommon&r, &9Rare&r, &5Epic&r, &6Legendary&r, &dMythic&r. Out here they fall about 60, 26, 9.5, 3.5, 0.9 and 0.1 times in a hundred. Hold &eShift&r over a bag for its real odds, sampled from what this land put inside: runes, Tempering and Lustrous Stones, Remnant Shards, whetstones, tomes and food.
&7Four bags of a tier craft into one of the next; one splits back into four. Hold use to open a bag, or sneak to open the whole stack. Craft a Rare bag from four Uncommons.

quests.title: A Rabbit's Foot, Gilded
quests.subtitle: Luck you can carry.
description: &6Bag Luck&r tilts every drop toward the better tiers. It comes from &6Looting&r on your weapon, your &6Luck&r, the size of what you killed, the Nether, the End and a hard world.

A &6Fortune Talisman&r (an emerald, gold and a rabbit's foot) carried anywhere on you is a whole point of Bag Luck, and a quarter more bags besides. Pell's advice: luck can be trained too. The Tallyman's &6Exploration&r attribute is Luck by another name.
&7Make a Fortune Talisman.

quests.title: &eThe Bag Opener
quests.subtitle: Pell's fingers are older than the Eclipse.
description: Pell would like a machine. A &6Bag Opener&r is iron, a hopper, redstone, an emerald and a chest: nine bags in, eighteen stacks out. Hoppers feed it from the top and sides and empty it from the bottom. It waits for Hourglass bags to ripen, and a comparator can read it.
&7Four redstone modes: always on, on with a signal, on without one, or one bag per pulse. Build a Bag Opener.

quests.title: One Mob's Trash
quests.subtitle: Rotten flesh, ground into hope.
description: Rotten flesh, bones, string, arrows, feathers: every grave field leaves the same junk. A &6Loot Recycler&r (iron, a grindstone, smooth stone, a composter and redstone) grinds it into salvage points, and every &664 points&r becomes a fresh Common bag. Pearls, blaze rods, ghast tears and old weapons are worth more.
Feed it bags you don't want and it keeps their experience until you take it.
&7Build a Loot Recycler.

quests.title: Worth the Wait
quests.subtitle: A promise the dead couldn't keep.
description: An &6Hourglass&r bag is still keeping time for someone. Carry it five to ten minutes and it ripens into &5two bags of Epic or better&r, with a handful of bottled experience. The Bag Opener knows to wait for it.
&7Three bags in a hundred are Hourglasses. Let one ripen and open it.

quests.title: Stones for the Smith
quests.subtitle: What tempering is made of.
description: The Smith Under Ash tempers with what the dead leave behind, and the dead leave it in bags. &5Epic&r bags pay &6Tempering Stones&r V and VI, &6Lustrous Stones&r II and III, the six affinity &6whetstones&r, Radiant runes and Sovereign Fragments. Rare bags carry the lower stones; Legendary the higher ones.
&o"I don't ask where you found them,"&r says the Smith. &o"I ask how many."&r
&7Open an Epic Loot Bag.

quests.title: &6Jackpot
quests.subtitle: Somebody held on very hard.
description: Legendary bags come from the dead who held on hardest. They pay &6Hero's runes&r, Tempering Stones VII and VIII, Lustrous Stones IV to VI, &6Tomes of Ascension&r, a Tear of Rebirth, and now and then a Hallowed Tear or a Sunseed. The whole world hears when one drops.
Bad luck runs out. Twelve kills without a bag and the next one drops one; twenty bags below Rare and the next is Rare; two hundred without a Legendary and the next is &6Legendary&r.
&7Open a Legendary Loot Bag.

quests.title: Safecracker
quests.subtitle: Sealed by someone who meant to come back.
description: Cut a &6Diamond Key&r from a diamond on a stonecutter. It is used up, and it only has to be somewhere on you. Inside a &bLocked&r bag is the old world's best: always one piece of enchanted &5netherite&r gear, and two or three of netherite ingots, diamonds, ancient debris, a smithing template, a totem or a golden apple.
Netherite won't answer a weak hand. Read the gear's lock, then the Tallyman's &eK&r screen, before you get excited.
&7One bag in a hundred comes out Locked. Cut a key and open one.

quests.title: Tempting Fate
quests.subtitle: Something packed this bag with a grudge.
description: A &cCursed&r bag rolls the dice when you open it. Half the time three to five &ccursed&r monsters rise around you, glowing, and each one you kill drops a bag of its own. Sometimes it's a &6Legendary&r jackpot. Sometimes a hex that lasts twelve seconds. Sometimes something stranger.
&7Two bags in a hundred come out Cursed. Open one with your back to a wall.

quests.title: Pocket Bestiary
quests.subtitle: The dead carry their grudges too.
description: A &6Summoning&r bag is a sack of spawn eggs: zombies, skeletons, creepers, spiders, slimes, a ghast if the dead disliked you. Open it somewhere with a door you can close.
&7Open a Summoning Loot Bag.

quests.title: &dMyth Made Real
quests.subtitle: One bag in a thousand.
description: One bag in a thousand is &dMythic&r, or you make one from four Legendaries and a &6nether star&r. Every boss this land knows (the Old Powers, the Cataclysm's monsters, the Realm's wardens and the rest) drops three bags of Epic or better when it dies, each with a fifteen-in-a-hundred chance of Mythic. Inside: Sovereign runes, Lustrous Stones VII to IX, Sovereign stones, Tomes of Ascension.
Pell turns the empty bag over in his hands. &o"Someone carried this all the way down. Wonder what they meant to buy with it."&r He sells the stories to the Archivist; the bags he keeps.
&7Open a Mythic Loot Bag.
